key_insight: REGEN turns expert RL replay buffers into reusable offline training data, enabling expert-to-generalist distillation without expensive online rollouts.
engineering_relevance: It offers a cheaper, more scalable post-training pipeline for LLMs by decoupling data generation from optimization while preserving performance.
method: Recycle replay memory produced during specialized RL training
Train the generalist with offline RL instead of multi-teacher on-policy distillation
Eliminate coupled rollout sampling and backward passes to cut compute
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that REGEN matches MOPD accuracy across mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following at substantially lower cost.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality, diversity, and coverage of the recycled replay data, which could limit transfer to new tasks or weaker teachers.
paper_title: REGEN: Replay-recycling for Expert-to-Generalist distillation with Offline Reinforcement Learning
